truths.truth: `risk-check run --base <ref> --staged` is the staged scope's one machine spelling: it scans the index, records staged:true with head/head_id null, refuses --head beside it, and reads only what is added
truths.evidence: risk-check.mjs:150-183 (staged read by presence, both-spellings bad-args, widened neither-present bad-args), :307-350 (staged arm branches BEFORE resolveRange). Scratch repo: staged jwt.sign file -> ok:true, matches [{category:'auth'}], staged:true, base_id set, head:null, head_id:null; the same content only in the worktree -> matches:[], checked:true, empty:true; `--base HEAD --head HEAD --staged` -> ok:false reason 'bad-args' and the trace row count did not move (2 before, 2 after). lib/arg-contract.mjs:785-798 declares '--staged' boolean/fallback and '--head' required:false. Suite: 'risk-check run: --base <ref> --staged scans the INDEX and records it as staged', '--staged reads the INDEX alone - an unadded worktree file is outside it', 'an EMPTY index is a completed empty check, not an unchecked one', '--head and --staged together are two spellings of one scope, refused', 'a REF-RANGE row carries no `staged` field at all'.

truths.truth: A staged record binds to the index tree it actually diffed - index_id is git write-tree's id and the body is diffed <base> <tree>, so the id and the bytes are one object
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning/core.mjs:581-586 (resolveIndex via `git -C top write-tree`, error opens with 'index'); risk-check.mjs:343-348 builds diffArgs as ['-C', top, 'diff', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-textconv', b.id, ix.id, '--', ...REVIEWER_TEXT_PATHSPECS] - never --cached. Scratch repo: the staged run reported index_id 1bc435775687e49920f9308a73a76f077c8b5fdc and `git write-tree` printed the same id; staging one more byte then re-asking status -> state 'stale', so a moved index does not answer for the scanned one. Suite: 'risk-check run: a staged row carries the INDEX id, the identity its base cannot carry', 'risk-check status: a staged record does not answer for a LATER index', 'a staged record carrying NO index id is never a match'.

truths.truth: After a plan records risk_check_skipped, the blocking risk_surface gate stays satisfiable - a later plan's `risk-check status` still passes
truths.evidence: `risk_check_skipped` exists nowhere in the seam: `grep -rn risk_check_skipped --include='*.mjs' --include='*.json'` outside .planning returns exactly one hit, the prose-agreement test constant at cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:3769. cmdRiskCheckStatus builds its `records`/`byPlan` maps from `e.family === 'outcome' && e.event === 'risk_check'` only (risk-check.mjs:800-803), while `completed` counts EVERY in-cycle cad-executor return bracket (:759-765) - so a plan whose only outcome row is a skip lands in `rows` with no record and reports `missing`. Reproduced against the real binary in a scratch repo: plan 1 dispatched/returned with only a `risk_check_skipped` row, plan 2 committed and ran a clean `risk-check run`; `risk-check status --phase 1 --plan 2 --base <pre> --head HEAD` answered {ok:false, reason:'risk-record-missing', plans:[{plan:'1',state:'missing'},{plan:'2',state:'recorded'}]}. Replacing plan 1's skip with the pre-phase `checked:true, empty:true` row in the same repo answered {ok:true, plans:[{plan:'1',state:'recorded'},{plan:'2',state:'recorded'}]}, so this is a behaviour change introduced by plan 2 task 3, not a pre-existing state.

gaps.name: A skipped plan makes the NEXT plan's risk-check status refuse, so the blocking gate cannot be cleared
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the seam does not read the event the workflows now write. `risk_check_skipped` is prose-only: cmdRiskCheckStatus counts every in-cycle cad-executor return bracket into `completed` (risk-check.mjs:759-765) but only `outcome/risk_check` rows into `records`/`byPlan` (:800-803), so a plan whose only outcome row is the skip reports `missing` and the whole call answers ok:false. execute.md:404 says 'The plan is NOT reported done while that call refuses', so a phase where an EARLIER plan lands no commits can no longer report a LATER plan done - the unsatisfiable blocking gate whose only exit is an override.
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning/risk-check.mjs:759-765 and :800-803 (the two scans disagree on which events count); `grep -rn risk_check_skipped` outside .planning finds only cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:3769, i.e. no seam consumer. Scratch repo against the real binary: plan 1 = dispatch/return + `risk_check_skipped`, plan 2 = a commit + a clean `risk-check run`; `risk-check status --phase 1 --plan 2 --base <pre> --head HEAD` -> {ok:false, reason:'risk-record-missing', plans:[{plan:'1',state:'missing'},{plan:'2',state:'recorded'}]}. The same repo with the pre-phase `checked:true, empty:true` row for plan 1 answers ok:true, both plans 'recorded'. cadence-core/workflows/execute.md:341-356 and cadence-core/references/execute-parallel.md:34-42 are the two sites that now emit the skip on a multi-plan path.
gaps.missing: Teach cmdRiskCheckStatus about the skip: read `outcome/risk_check_skipped` rows into the same per-plan join and let a skip whose `sha` matches the plan's recorded end satisfy that plan's row (a distinct reported state, e.g. `skipped`, rather than silently `recorded`, so a reader can still tell a skip from a check). Add a risk-diff.test.mjs row that dispatches/returns two plans, skips the first and records the second, and asserts the second's named-range status answers ok:true. Alternatively narrow the prose so the skip is only taken on the LAST plan - but that leaves the same hole on execute-parallel.md, where every plan's status runs after every merge.
